svg.title: Fractured Highway — Split highway viaduct
svg.desc: A repaired timber bypass threads below a fractured stone highway. Climb the crane scaffold to recover road markers; no broken span is the sole onward route. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A repaired timber bypass threads below a fractured stone highway. Climb the crane scaffold
to recover road markers; no broken span is the sole onward route.
8 raised landings · 2 stairs · 3 ropes · 3 ladders · 26 props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Waystone Mile · P2 Warden Caravan Rest
Encounter: Hedge Nibbler · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
